notes.title: Price Drop
notes.notes:
We think [b]Juggly[/b] deserves to be played by everyone, that's why today we have reduced the price so that you have [b]no excuse[/b] not to buy it. 

Think about how you can help two young and enthusiastic developers achieve their life goal of double digits sales, we're only 6 away and from statistical analysis of previous sales we think we can do this by Christmas 2023.

So have one less coffee, instead get the instant hit of Juggly and make Christmas come early!

notes.title: Version 1.02 now available
notes.notes:
[b]Juggly[/b] is now better than ever with the following improvements:

[list]
[*] New how to play section with examples and explanations!
[*] Fixed bug that caused cursor to go AWOL
[*] Made random speed level 10 a bit easier
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Juggly.

[b]Happy New Year! [/b]

notes.title: Juggly Launch!
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce the launch today of our first game [b]Juggly[/b].

From the initial idea 3 years ago Juggly has evolved into the game you see today. We're two brothers who enjoy making strategy games that aren't your typical fare. We hope you enjoy playing Juggly and find your way to the top of the leaderboards.

Thanks!
